main_text.p: Quod si quis inquirat in rationes Theologicas, illæ non contemnendæ, quibus manifesto probatur, etiam concessione Principis inita duella inter socios, esse illicita. 1. Quia nullibi sacra pagina talia litium componendarum, ac diffidiorum amputandorum remedia pręscripsit: ut nostrum non sit, aut Principis cujusvis talia remedia eligere. Idq; ne videamur velle Deo esse sapientiores. Quapropter etiam ecclesiastici in Anglia circa ann.1630. Carolo regi dissuaserunt, ne duorum Scotorum congressum permitteret, qui tamen licentiam singularis certaminis impetraverant. Alter eorum erat Comes de Ree, alter nobilis, vocatus Maexwel. Et tantum Theologorum rationes apud Regem valuerunt ut duellatores à proposito revocaverit. 2. Quia medium illud fru-
main_text.notes: Printed "fi" in the first line is long s followed by i, read as "si". Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The printed "diffuaferunt" is read as "dissuaserunt" from the long s forms. "prescripsit" is written with ę as printed ("pręscripsit"); the ę may be a printer's ligature and is uncertain. "ann.1630." is printed without a space; kept as printed. The word "fru-" at the foot is hyphenated across the page break and continues on the next page.
